sources.snippet: Complete benchmarks and a fully validated, stable feature set Pull request contributions We welcome feedback - please feel free to raise issues and pull requests in this repository. Previous releases: N1.6 | N1.5 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 is an open vision-language-action (VLA) model for generalized humanoid robot skills.

sources.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
sources.snippet: A robot foundation model, trained on massive and diverse data sources, is essential for enabling the robots to reason about novel situations, robustly handle real-world variability, and rapidly learn new tasks. To this end, we introduce GR00T N1, an open foundation model for humanoid robots.

sources.title: GR00T N1.7（An open-source, commercially licensable ... - 百度百科
sources.snippet: GR00T N1.7 is an open-source, commercially licensable Visual-Language-Action (VLA) Humanoid Robot foundation model released by NVIDIA in 2026. It belongs to the NVIDIA Isaac GR00T family of open models and is designed to map visual observations and natural language instructions into continuous robot actions, demonstrating feasibility for real-world commercial deployment.
